purpose: First-pass graded relevance example for Stage 2 retrieval evaluation.
labeling_note: These labels are provisional and require human review before being used as a benchmark.

relevance_scale.1: Marginally relevant; shares a topic but does not satisfy the main constraints.
relevance_scale.2: Useful match; satisfies part of the intent but misses an important constraint.
relevance_scale.3: Excellent match; directly addresses a four-day bench-focused program request.

candidates.reason: Likely useful because it offers training programs, but the query-specific four-day bench structure is not guaranteed from the candidate title alone.
